title: 第 8 章 这该死的女人
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
过了一会儿以后陈默走出房间来到院子外面，只见外面的天色已经暗了下来。

    站在院子里的他深吸了一口气然后打开了系统面板。

    【宿主已完成残害同门的恶行，并奖励上品法术风雷掌，修炼后可掌御风雷威力无穷。】

    系统的提示刚消失他就感觉到一股信息涌入了脑海，接着风雷掌的修炼法门口诀运功路线全部都刻在了他脑子里，虽然这系统虽然抽象不过给的东西倒是实打实的。

    上品法术说给就给一点都不吝啬。

    接着他闭上眼睛按照脑海中的修炼方法开始运转体内的真元，能感觉到真元在经脉中流淌顺着特定的路线运行。

    只见一股力量在掌心凝聚，当陈默睁开眼睛以后第一时间抬起右手。

    掌心之中隐隐有雷光闪烁并且发出细微的声音。

    此刻的他满意的点了点头，看的出来这风雷掌的威力确实不俗比他现在修炼的任何法术都要强，于是又练了一会儿直到把风雷掌的几个基本招式都熟练了才停下来。

    擦了擦额头上的汗他转身回了屋里。

    ……

    而同一时间内的陆瑶怒气冲冲的离开了陈默的院子之后便一路朝着后山走去，只见她的脸上还带着那个红手印，而且身上的衣服也脏兮兮的看起来狼狈极了。

    一路上遇到好几个弟子都用异样的眼光看着她，忽然觉得那些目光就像刀一样扎在她身上。

    因此她在心里恨恨的想着，陈默你给我等着我一定要让你付出代价。

    走着走着她就来到了后山的一处洞府门前，这里是陆云的修炼之地平时不允许外人靠近。

    “哥你在吗？”她冲着里面喊了一声。

    洞府的门打开了随后里面就传出一个声音。

    “进来吧。”

    接着她走进去之后就看到陆云坐在石椅上手里端着一杯茶，在他旁边还站着两个小弟正是今天白天跟在陆云身边的那两个弟子。

    “哥你要给我做主。”陆瑶一进门就开口而且声音里带着哭腔。

    那陆云看到她的样子眉头立刻皱了起来，“你怎么弄成这样谁欺负你了？”

    “是陈默。”她咬着牙说道。

    “陈默？”

    “就是林凤瑶的那个道侣那个练气期的废物？他能把你打成这样？”陆云有些不敢相信。

    “他也不知道用了什么手段实力突然变得很强如今的我根本不是他的对手，而且他不但抢了我的灵石还把我的玉佩也抢走了。”

    “你看我脸上的伤就是他打的。”她指着自己的脸给陆云看，而陆云看到自己妹妹脸上的红手印脸色当场就沉了下来。

    旁边的两个小弟也纷纷开口。

    “这个陈默也太嚣张了吧连陆瑶师妹都敢打？”

    “上次他还当着陆云师兄的面打伤了林师兄这次又欺负陆瑶师妹，我看他分明是没把陆云师兄放在眼里。”
content_en:
After a while, Chen Mo walked out of the room and outside the yard, and saw that the sky outside had darkened.

    Standing in the yard, he took a deep breath and opened the system panel.

    [The host has completed the evil deeds of killing his fellow sect members, and was rewarded with the top-grade spell Wind and Thunder Palm. After practice, he can control the wind and thunder with infinite power. 】

    As soon as the system prompts disappeared, he felt an influx of information pouring into his mind, and then all the training methods and routes of Wind and Thunder Palm were engraved in his mind. Although the system was abstract, the things it gave were real.

    It’s not stingy at all to give out top-grade magic spells.

    Then he closed his eyes and started to circulate the true energy in his body according to the cultivation method in his mind. He could feel the true energy flowing in the meridians and following specific routes.

    I saw a force gathering in the palm of my hand. When Chen Mo opened his eyes, he immediately raised his right hand.

    There was a faint flash of lightning in the palm of the hand and a subtle sound was made.

    At this moment, he nodded with satisfaction. It could be seen that the power of the Wind and Thunder Palm was indeed stronger than any spell he had practiced now, so he practiced for a while until he was proficient in several basic moves of the Wind and Thunder Palm before stopping.

    Wiping the sweat from his forehead, he turned and returned to the house.

    …

    At the same time, Lu Yao left Chen Mo's yard angrily and walked all the way towards the back mountain. She still had the red handprint on her face, and the clothes on her body were dirty and looked extremely embarrassed.

    Along the way, she met several disciples who looked at her strangely, and suddenly she felt that those eyes were piercing her like knives.

    Therefore, she thought bitterly in her heart, Chen Mo, just wait for me and I will make you pay the price.

    As she walked, she came to the door of a cave in the back mountain. This was Lu Yun's training place and outsiders were not allowed to approach.

    "Brother, are you there?" She shouted inside.

    The door of the cave opened and then a voice came from inside.

    "Come in."

    Then she walked in and saw Lu Yun sitting on a stone chair with a cup of tea in his hand. Next to him were two younger disciples who were following Lu Yun during the day.

    "Brother, you have to make the decision for me." Lu Yao spoke as soon as she entered the door, with a cry in her voice.

    When Lu Yun saw her look, he immediately frowned, "Why did you end up like this? Who bullied you?"

    "It's Chen Mo." She gritted her teeth and said.

    "Chen Mo?"

    "That Taoist companion of Lin Fengyao was a loser in his Qi training period? How could he beat you like this?" Lu Yun couldn't believe it.

    "He doesn't know what means he used to suddenly become very strong. Now I am no match for him, and he not only took away my spiritual stone but also my jade pendant."

    "You see, the injuries on my face were caused by him." She pointed to her face and showed it to Lu Yun. Lu Yun's face darkened on the spot when he saw the red handprints on his sister's face.

    The two younger brothers next to him also spoke one after another.

    "This Chen Mo is too arrogant, right? He even dares to hit Junior Sister Lu Yao?"

    "Last time he injured Senior Brother Lin in front of Senior Brother Lu Yun and this time he bullied Junior Sister Lu Yao. I think he clearly doesn't take Senior Brother Lu Yun seriously."
